think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type, units, and documented valid range. 2) Check whether any specific numeric value (e.g., 0, -1) is documented to switch the knob into a qualitatively different mode (disable/auto/special behavior) rather than just “smaller/larger effect”. 3) If such a value exists, classify as a special knob and record that value; otherwise classify as non-special.
